'''Version 1.9.3''' was an update for the Scape and Run: Parasites Mod, released on April 3rd 2022.  It was 9.13 MB.

== ''Change Log'' ==

====<u>New options</u>==== 

*Added category for [[Primitive Devourer|Devourer]]
*"[[Scent System|Scent]] Debug"
*"Regen Timer"

====<u>Mobs</u>==== 

*Parasites with charge attack<ref>At this time, this included the [[Assimilated Cow]], [[Primitive Reeker]], [[Adapted Reeker]], and [[Warden]]</ref>:
*#Before making the actual charge they will have to wait a little and their body will start to shake.
*#They will not begin to do aoe damage until the charge has begun 

*Tweaked [[Adapted Reeker]], [[Warden]] charge attack speed
*Removed Adapted Reeker damage aura
*[[:Category:Ancient Parasites|Ancient versions]] regeneration reduced by half
